title: Panoramic Electric Bike Tour of Quebec City
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us for a 25 km guided electric bike tour offering a unique perspective of Québec City and its surroundings. This scenic ride combines breathtaking views, beautiful landscapes, and iconic landmarks for an unforgettable experience.

The tour starts with a relaxing ferry ride across the St. Lawrence River to the South Shore, where you'll enjoy panoramic views of the North Shore, including the iconic Québec City skyline and the majestic Château Frontenac from a distance.

On the South Shore, ride along the river and take in the tranquil beauty of the area, with incredible photo opportunities of the city and river. Discover the hidden gem of the Etchemin River, where nature offers peace and serenity.

This electric bike tour is a perfect blend of adventure, comfort, and stunning views, providing an unforgettable way to experience Québec City's landscapes from a unique angle. Note: Good physical condition is required for this tour.
